bad.title: News blocks the inbox
bad.text: People came to read Sam’s email, and a release note stands in the way.

bad.title: Got it is the only way out
bad.text: Most people press it without reading a word, so the news is lost anyway.

good.title: One line above the mail
good.text: “New: smarter search.” The inbox works right away, with Sam’s email one click off.

good.title: See what’s new, when people want it
good.text: The details open in place, only for those who ask.

good.title: Close it and it’s gone
good.text: People who don’t care remove the note with one click.

bad.title: Archive asks first
bad.text: Archiving loses nothing, yet each one takes two clicks.

bad.title: The same “Are you sure?” every time
bad.text: Archive and Delete get the same box with OK, so people stop reading it.

bad.title: Every action costs a second click
bad.text: Two archives and one delete come to 6 clicks.

good.title: Archive happens at once
good.text: One click, and the chat leaves the list.

good.title: Undo, in case of a slip
good.text: The toast stays 5 seconds, so a wrong archive costs one more click.

good.title: Delete chat names the loss
good.text: The dialog says all messages and photos go for good, and the button says Delete chat.
good.wait: Press a trash icon to see this.

bad.title: Eight fields over the chart
bad.text: The dialog covers the bars, so people can’t see which day was slowest.
bad.wait: Press Edit report to see this.

bad.title: The chart people need to check
bad.text: Wednesday’s 0.8k is the low point, but the form hides it once it opens.

bad.title: An alert that fires at once
bad.text: Guess 900 and Wednesday’s $800 is already below it.
bad.wait: Press Edit report, type 900 as the alert and save to see this.

good.title: Settings in a side panel
good.text: All eight fields have room to scroll beside the chart.
good.wait: Press Edit report to see this.

good.title: The chart stays in view
good.text: People can read Wednesday’s 0.8k while they type the alert.

good.title: Set the alert just under 800
good.text: With the chart beside it, people type 750 and get it right the first time.
good.wait: Press Edit report to see this.

bad.title: Cancel could mean either
bad.text: Cancel the crop or cancel leaving? People have to read the whole question.

bad.title: OK has focus and drops the crop
bad.text: Pressing Enter out of habit throws the edit away.

good.title: Keep editing has focus
good.text: Enter keeps the crop, the safe choice when people act on habit.

good.title: Discard crop names the loss
good.text: The red button says what it throws away, so the buttons alone answer the question.

bad.title: Rate us before doing anything
bad.text: People haven’t played a song yet, so they close it unread.
bad.wait: Press Reset and wait a moment to see this.

bad.title: A rating with nothing to rate
bad.text: Asked before any use, Rate now gets a guess at best.
bad.wait: Press Reset and wait a moment to see this.

good.title: The library, with nothing in front
good.text: Road trip, Focus and Chill are ready to play from the start.

good.title: Download asks about mobile data
good.text: Road trip is 240 MB off Wi‑Fi, so people read the question before they answer.

good.title: Wait for Wi‑Fi has focus
good.text: The choice that saves data is the default.

bad.title: The reply gets a 160 px strip
bad.text: The panel is narrower than the email it answers.

bad.title: A few words per line
bad.text: The draft wraps every few words, so people can’t read back what they wrote.

good.title: The reply takes the full width
good.text: The draft reads in long lines, like the email it answers.

good.title: ← Inbox keeps the draft
good.text: People can check Sam’s notes and come back to the same text.

bad.title: Filters take half the phone
bad.text: A 140 px panel leaves the shoes a sliver beside it.

bad.title: Shoes squeezed into a thin column
bad.text: With the panel open, names and prices are too cramped to compare.

good.title: Filters cover the whole screen
good.text: Sizes S, M and L get the full width, with nothing squeezed beside them.

good.title: Show results gives a count
good.text: Pick M and it reads Show 4 results, before people leave the filters.

good.title: Close is in the corner
good.text: People get back to the full-size shoes in one tap.

bad.title: Each button opens its own panel
bad.text: Outline, Comments and History stack up side by side instead of taking turns.

bad.title: The doc shrinks with each panel
bad.text: With all three open, the trip plan becomes a thin strip.

good.title: Buttons switch what the panel shows
good.text: Comments replaces Outline in the same spot, so the layout doesn’t move.

good.title: The doc keeps its width
good.text: Only one panel ever sits beside the trip plan.

bad.title: A dim layer over the photos
bad.text: The gray tells people the photos are off-limits, so they don’t think to click them.

bad.title: Info is stuck on IMG_201
bad.text: Clicking another photo closes the panel instead of showing its details.

good.title: Photos stay bright and clickable
good.text: Nothing says hands off, so people try the next photo.

good.title: Info follows the selected photo
good.text: Pick IMG_203 and the panel shows 4.0 MB, taken 13 Aug.
